summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## ARCA-61 Plan (no code changes made — read-only audit only)  **What I did:** Traced the full watchlist read/write path end to end without editing anything: `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts` → SQLite schema.  **What I found (this changes the starting assumption):** - The frontend has **no localStorage/anonymous fallback** for watchlists (only theme preference uses localStorage). Every read/write goes through `api.get/post/delete`, which sets `credentials: "include"` on every request — coo
